vak32vfr.variantName: COSTWAY 4.5FT Artificial Christmas With 8 LED Lighting Modes-Green
vak32vfr.sourceDescription: Experience the magic of the holiday season with this stunning Christmas tree. It flawlessly replicates the beauty of a real tree, boasting vivid branch tips and lush mixed foliage. Made of premium PE and PVC, it is fireproof, not easy to deform and easy to maintain, while remaining allergy-free and smell-free. But the beauty doesn't stop there. Adorned with warm white LED lights, this Christmas tree exudes a warm white and enchanting glow. With 8 different dynamic lighting modes, including combination, sequential, chasing/flash, twinkle/flash and more, you have the power to create the perfect ambiance for your guests. A simple installation is ensured by the hinged design. Branch tips will automatically expand, you just need to watch the magic unfold before your very eyes. More superior details, we've even included a pair of gloves to protect your hands during setup. Finally, with a folding metal stand, this Christmas tree has a stable frame and will bring the festive magic to your home, office, shop, school, etc. Merry Christmas! Realistic and Safe Decoration: Crafted with attention to detail, this Christmas tree replicates the beauty of a real tree, which is completed with vivid branch tips and lush mixed foliage. Plus, selected PE and PVC make it resist fire and deformations, while not causing allergies and having no weird smells. Ideal Sparkling Illumination: The Xmas tree is adorned with warm white lights, creating an enchanting holiday vibe. Meanwhile, its LED lights present better quality, proven by lower energy consumption, higher safety and a longer lifespan. Attractive 8-Mode Lighting: The pre-lit Xmas tree will refresh your cherished holiday, since it comes with 8 different dynamic modes, including slow fade, in waves, steady on, etc. More, with your safety in mind, it's fitted with a secured adaptor, which will help you control the lighting mode. Hinged Design and Easy Setup: Thanks to the section hinged frame, the Christmas tree can be installed effortlessly in minutes, as branch tips will automatically expand. Besides, the package includes a pair of gloves to protect your hands from injuries. Stability for Versatile Use: Supported by a folding metal stand, the Xmas tree gains perfect stability, while its anti-slip foot pads will keep the floor from being scratched. Whether placed in the office, home or shop, it will add a touch of festive magic to any space. Bendable Curved Top: Playfully adjustable, this holiday tree's upper section bends freely to craft your favourite whimsical silhouette. Shape it into a charming curled curve or keep it straight, letting you customize the festive look with effortless fun. Mellow Holiday Radiance: Pre-strung with 210 LED lights, this flocked Xmas tree glows in creamy warm white tones. Paired with a UL certified adapter, the gentle light spills soft golden hues across your space, painting a sweet, inviting holiday mood all season long. A folding metal stand offers solid support and compact storage, while bonus gloves shield your hands from sharp branch edges, so you can breeze through setup in no time. High-Quality Material: Made of premium PVC, this playful holiday tree holds its lush green look season after season, resisting fading over years of holiday use. It features flame-retardant, allergy-safe and smell-free traits, bringing reassuring peace of mind for your indoor festive celebrations.
